subject: world_language
concept: Combining likes/dislikes, animals, food, and questions into a short simple conversation
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A1 'simple interaction' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences conversation-phrase cards into a coherent short exchange
exercise.abstract: Student performs a short spoken or written conversation combining all skills from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: conversation includes a question, an answer with a like/dislike, and at least one named item (animal or food)
misconception_flags: combines phrases in an order that wouldn't form a coherent real conversation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
